Welcome to Leaders Road.

This channel documents a practical, systems-based approach to using automation, AI tools, and structured strategies to improve efficiency, decision-making, and long-term execution.

Content is shared from personal experience and is intended for educational purposes only. Nothing on this channel should be considered financial advice.

For those interested in exploring the tools, frameworks, and discussions in more depth, there is a private Telegram community linked below.

Progress is built through structure, consistency, and informed decisions.

Smart MEV is a DeFi trading automation protocol that uses MEV strategies to interact directly with blockchain transactions. In this video, I show how the system works, how I used it, and what happens when a 100-day contract ends, including a live withdrawal.

One of the main reasons I decided to test this protocol is transparency. Transactions, wallets, and activity can be verified directly on the blockchain, and funds remain under user control through smart contracts.
